notes: Washington Park fills the area Elm to Race between the rear of the 14th Street lots (stone wall, y ~1010) and West 12th; no street crosses it. Points use block lines (lot fronts), not the water pipes, which are off-centre in several streets. West 14th: only its south line is on the sheet (north line falls at or above the paper edge); centre = south line minus half the printed width: 50 ft west of Race (centre y 263), printed 33 ft east of Race (centre y ~272), so Race/14th is a cross at the mean y 268. The north side of 14th is off the paper, so whether Pine Alley, Pleasant and Spruce Alley continue north cannot be seen (marked T; check sheet 76). Vine/14th marked T: the east line of Vine runs unbroken from y ~227 to Mercer, so no 14th Street leg leaves Vine eastward at this level. Republic Street: printed REPUBLIC on both blocks; the original names are printed as '(BREMEN)' north of 13th and 'ANTWERP' between 13th and 12th; it ends at 12th (block 8 lots run straight across). Republic printed 33 ft near 14th and 32 ft near 12th. Race printed 63'8" near 14th and 66'8" at the parkway. Mercer (printed MERCER, ~34 ft between lines, width not printed) enters from the east (Volume 2 area) and ends at Vine. West 13th starts at Race (park to the west) and continues east of Vine (name printed only as W. 13TH). West 12th continues east of Vine (blocks drawn in outline only). Grant and Charles come in from sheet 65 and end at Elm; their widths are not printed on this sheet. Unnamed alleys: 10 ft N-S alley through block 5 at x ~2475 from 13th to 12th; two 10 ft N-S alleys through block 7 (x ~950 and ~1513) from 12th to the north line of West Central Parkway; in block 8 a 10 ft N-S alley at x ~2535 from 12th to the parkway (about 20 ft wide between y ~3865 and ~4250, printed 20'), a 10 ft N-S alley at x ~3097 (4" W.P.) from 12th to the parkway, and a 30 ft E-W court at y ~3815 joining the two. West Central Parkway (printed 'W. CENTRAL (W.N. CANAL) PARKWAY', 48 ft roadway) runs along the foot of the sheet: only its north line (y ~4480) is on the paper and the corridor centre is off the sheet, so Elm, Race and Vine crossings with it are not recorded (same as sheet 65).
